text.description_html:
Grade 1 Polished Brass Door Closer

The Global TC612-US3 Polished Brass Door Closer are our most economically priced Grade 1 (Best Grade) full cover closer. They are recommended for use on commercial, architectural and institutional applications. Ideal for business, new construction and renovations.

Also available: ADA Compliant Polished Brass Door Closer

Global Series TC612-US3 Door Closers are non-handed and have individual adjustments for sweep speed, latch speed, and backcheck cushioning. They are tri packed for regular, top jamb or parallel arm installations. They fit 11-3/32" x 3/4" mounting hole pattern and packaged complete with wood and machine screws.

Features and Specifications for Global TC612-US3 Polished Brass Door Closer

  • Adjustable closing speed
  • Adjustable latching speed
  • Adjustable back check
  • Aluminum Alloy Shell
  • Horizontal Mounting Holes: 11-3/32"
  • Vertical Mounting Holes: 3/4"
  • Maximum Door Size: 60" interior / 48" exterior
  • Maximum Door Weight: 258 lbs
  • Spring Tension: Adjustable 2 - 6
  • Tri packed for regular, top jamb or parallel arm mounting
  • Non Handed
  • Optional Hold Open
  • UL 10C Approved
  • Includes Full Plastic Cover
  • Grade 1 Certified
  • 15 Year Warranty
  • US3 Polished Brass Finish
  • TC600 Series Instructions

You can add an optional Polished Brass Friction Hold Open Arm with Parallel Bracket below.



*Note: This item is currently on Back Order from the manufacturer. Please use PDQ Polished Brass Door Closer .
